title: Tabbed Settings & Working Offline Mode
changes: Settings is now organized into tabs — Learning, Character, Account, Data & Offline, and About — instead of one long scrolling page. Your last-opened tab is remembered.

Fixes a major Offline Mode bug: Kaishi's core vocabulary, kana, manga, conversation, theatre, grammar and mnemonic data were never actually being saved for offline use, so the app could fail to start at all once offline — even with an offline pack downloaded. That data is now included automatically.

Fixes offline status incorrectly showing as offline: connection state is now confirmed with a real network check instead of trusting the browser's connection flag alone, and Kaishi self-heals if the connection quietly comes back.
Downloading any Offline Pack (Essential, Standard or Full) now reliably lets you keep using Kaishi Quest with no internet connection at all.
